integrity: The proof supplies analytic necessity and sufficiency in all three parameter regimes. The included exact algebra checker is supplementary. Independent audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous trees are not covered; the classification is for the infinite (q+1)-regular tree with integer q at least two, 0<r<1 and real b. The statement relies on the established radial positive-kernel matrix criterion; originality is supported by a bounded literature search, not a proof of priority.
title: A sharp positive-definiteness cone and its collapse for first-order exponential kernels on regular trees
